column1: # Known-good, real-world Windows batch/cmd scripts used as a parse-regression
# These files are fetched on demand by fetch.sh (into ./fixtures/, gitignored)
# and parsed by check.sh, which fails if a file produces more ERROR nodes than
# allowed. They are NOT committed — they belong to their respective upstream
# max-errors is 0 for everything except scripts that exercise documented
# cpython's build.bat uses the `echo.message (parenthesised)` idiom, a documented
# grammar limitation (literal unquoted parentheses in arguments).
